parsed.post: Discarding 0.9159 as it's worse than my best (0.8727). It seems increasing capacity alone without tuning the learning rate/warmup for the deeper architecture is insufficient. I'm reverting to the global best (DEPTH=6, LR=0.06) and will next test lowering the learning rate to see if it stabilizes convergence for the deeper model.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if a more conservative learning rate helps the DEPTH=6 architecture converge better within the 5-minute window.
